name: Drifter's Leathers
description: Cracked leather patched at the elbows; it lets you run, climb and duck.

name: Drifter's Brigandine
description: Rusty plates sewn inside a coat that has seen too many roads.

name: Drifter's Scale Coat
description: Mismatched scales scavenged from three different coats; heavy on the shoulders.

name: Recruit's Gambeson
description: A quilted training jacket, still smelling of the barracks.

name: Recruit's Mail
description: A ring shirt a size too large, issued without asking.

name: Recruit's Plate
description: Old gate-ward plate; nothing gets through, and you get nowhere fast.
